items.title: What far cheaper AI compute in space could mean for Elon Musk
items.summary: In the Loop host Ejaaz Ahamadeen explains how SpaceX (SPCX) CEO Elon Musk's ability to scale AI compute on Earth, and potentially in space at a much lower cost, could make his space business a highly lucrative AI compute provider on par with the big cloud businesses like Amazon Web Services (AMZN), Google Cloud (GOOG) (GOOGL), and Microsoft's (MSFT) Azure.

items.title: NIO vs. Tesla: Which EV Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?

items.title: Fund Manager Lists Three Reasons He Still Won’t Buy Tesla Stock
items.summary: Gary Black, managing partner of The Future Fund LLC, sold his firm’s Tesla position in May 2025 at $356.

items.title: Tesla (TSLA) Is Spending €3 Billion To Expand Berlin Cybercab Production
items.summary: Tesla (NasdaqGS:TSLA) plans a €3b expansion of its Berlin Gigafactory to build fully autonomous Cybercabs at scale. The enlarged German plant is targeted to support output of up to 1 million driverless Cybercabs annually from 2029. Management expects the project to create thousands of additional roles at the Grünheide site as the facility shifts toward autonomy focused production.
